invariants.rationale: The method requires a WorkloadProfile parameter to operate, so it is expected to be non-null.
Profile should have a non-null input partition path stat map as the method iterates over its entrySet.
Covers the exhaustive possibilities for the input map, ensuring it's always a valid collection.
The method calls methods on the output partition path stat map, so it is expected to be non-null.
If output workload stats exist, then outputPartitionPathStatMap should not be null.
